2023_037_mar_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction report for March 2023 came before the Board of Education on May 16, 2023. Printed 5/11/2023 and paginated 1 through 41, it is a merchant-level ledger in which every line carries the transaction date 2/28/2023 and the journal-entry description MAR PCARD EXP, together with the budget unit, account code, transaction amount and any credit. The ledger closes with a Subtotal of 350,952.44 in charges against 7,253.94 in credits, and Total Expenses of 343,698.50.
2023_037_mar_2023_pcard_report.page:
Overview
Purchasing-card (PCARD) activity report of the Troy School District for March 2023, presented on the Board of Education agenda of May 16, 2023. Each of the 41 numbered pages repeats the banner "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, March 2023", the column headings Transaction Description / JE Description / Budget Unit / A/C Code / Transaction Amount / Credits, and the print date 5/11/2023. Every posting carries the transaction date 2/28/2023 and the journal-entry description MAR PCARD EXP; merchant names appear truncated as they came from the card processor (for example "AMZN MKTP US", "AMAZON.COM*H", "STAPLS737474", "GRAND TRAV R").

Identification and format
The item is the Troy School District purchasing-card (PCARD) report for March 2023, carried on the Board of Education agenda for the meeting of May 16, 2023 as "Mar 2023 PCARD Report". The file is a 41-page tabular extract; each page repeats the header line "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, March 2023" and the column row "Transaction Description  JE Description  Budget Unit  A/C Code  Transaction Amount  Credits", and each page footer pairs the page number with the print date 5/11/2023. Every detail line begins with the transaction date 2/28/2023, followed by a truncated merchant descriptor supplied by the card processor, the journal-entry description MAR PCARD EXP, a fifteen-digit budget unit, a four-digit account code, and either a transaction amount or a credit. The ledger ends with a Subtotal row of 350,952.44 in the Transaction Amount column and 7,253.94 in the Credits column, followed by Total Expenses of 343,698.50.
